Title: How To Free Up Space On Nintendo Switch (Best Method!)
IntroLines: Running out of storage space on your Nintendo Switch and can't download new games?
In this video, I'll show you the fastest and best methods to free up gigabytes of space without losing your save data.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 1: QUICK ARCHIVE UNPLAYED GAMES (BEST METHOD)
Steps: •  First, from your HOME Menu, open " System Settings " from the bottom toolbar.
•  Scroll down the left sidebar and select " Data Management " .
•  On the right side, select " Quick Archive " .
•  Browse through your installed titles and check the box next to any games you are not currently playing.
•  Check the bottom of the screen to see the total gigabytes of free space that will be created.
•  Select " Archive Data " on the right.
•  Select " Archive " to confirm.
•  Don't worry, your game save data is completely safe and icons remain on your home screen for easy redownload.
•  Finally, return to your HOME Menu and verify your newly freed storage space.
Sections.Bridge: If you want to keep all your games installed, let's move them over to your microSD card.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 2: MOVE GAMES TO YOUR MICROSD CARD
Steps: •  First, open " System Settings " from your HOME Menu.
•  Scroll down on the left and select " Data Management " .
•  Select " Move Data Between System / microSD Card " .
•  Select " Move to microSD Card " to clear your internal system memory.
•  Select the games or downloadable content you want to transfer.
•  Select " Move " on the right.
•  Select " Move Data " to start the transfer.
•  Wait a few moments for the data to copy over to your card.
•  Finally, check your system memory to verify that internal storage space has been cleared.
Sections.Bridge: If you still need extra space, let's clear out large captured videos and screenshots.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 3: DELETE CAPTURED VIDEOS AND SCREENSHOTS
Steps: •  First, return to your HOME Menu.
•  Open the " Album " app from the bottom toolbar.
•  Press the " Y " button on your controller to open the filter menu.
•  Select " Media Type " .
•  Choose " Videos Only " to find your largest capture files.
•  Press the " X " button on your controller to open management options.
•  Select " Delete Multiple Items " .
•  Check the boxes next to all the video clips you no longer need.
•  Select " Delete Selected Items " .
•  Select " Delete " to confirm.
•  Finally, return to your HOME Menu and check your available system storage.

OutroLines: And that's how you can easily free up storage space on your Nintendo Switch.
